key_findings: Olvanil activated sensory nerves and suppressed lung and liver metastasis of breast carcinoma without changing primary tumor growth.
Olvanil increased T cell counts, CD8+ T cell infiltration and IFN-gamma, with increased IL-10 and decreased IL-6.
